about.title: About Texas Dental Center
text: Texas Dental Center is owned by ⁦Dr. Amir Mofid, DDS⁩, and ⁦Dr. Amanda Glogowski, DDS⁩, general dentists.

Texas Dental Center was founded by Dr. Amir Mofid, DDS, who has cared for Houston patients since 2014. What began as a commitment to one neighborhood has grown into a full-service office where emergencies, oral surgery, restorations and family dentistry happen in the same place, with the same team.

Many of our patients come to us in pain. Others arrive after years of putting off treatment. Either way, we start the same way: we listen, we examine carefully with modern imaging, and we explain your options and the cost in plain language before anything begins.
